similarity_bar.definition: One-sided 95% related-group bootstrap lower bound of (candidate - reference) pooled common-four BA >= -1.5 pp, and no class's pooled recall more than 3 pp below the reference.
similarity_bar.declared: after the OOF results were seen; descriptive only, never a selection or promotion rule

simplicity_rule.rule: Plan section 7 sequential rule: start from each simplest candidate and move to the least complex more complex candidate whose paired 95% CI of OOF balanced-accuracy advantage over the current choice excludes zero; stop when none does. Reported for the fold bootstrap, the related-group bootstrap and both together. Complexity order: checkpoints, then members per OOF example.
simplicity_rule.interpretation: Descriptive OOF evidence on historically chosen candidates; not a promotion.
